title: RSA leading 0x00 in wh_Client_RsaFunction output: confirmed not a bug
description: Review flagged a potential bug: pkcs1_v15_unpad_verify assumes buf[0]==0x00 after RSA_PUBLIC_DECRYPT, worried wolfCrypt might strip the leading zero. CONFIRMED CORRECT: wc_RsaFunctionSync at rsa.c:2807 calls mp_to_unsigned_bin_len_ct(tmp, out, (int)*outLen) which always writes exactly outLen=keyLen bytes, left-padding with zeros as needed. The PKCS#1 block 00 01 FF...FF 00 msg is returned intact. No fix needed. This bead exists to document the research so future reviewers do not re-investigate.
